'''Sorchka''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] who was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A fair-skinned man with green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and brown hair and facial hair, he held the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], and was stationed at the [[Thul research camp]] in [[Kaamos Territory]], where he maintained communications with other outposts.<ref name="Mission" />
